law.purpose: P-75 slice B step 1 (r122 item 3): rain-shelter eave sub-slots. A sheltering resident (state=shelter, no umbrella quirk, deterministic h%10<3 bucket) relocates from the street home seat to the district eave slot; umbrella holders stay at the street home position (r122 law c); districts with no slot fall back to the home position (honest fallback, no fake shelter).
law.slot_class: seat-class stand position: the full r99 seat-harness gate family applies (body 1.333x1.333 @PPU24, grounding shadow, b1 nameplate 66x20 at +1.4167, tag framing, bubble ceiling +15)
law.eave_adjacency: at least one stand cell shares a full edge with the hosted building footprint; 14 building rects = NeonRules.Buildings (8) + GAME_ANNEX (southbank r103) + officeband E1/N1/N2/N3/N4 (r111)
hard_gates: underfoot row = floor(y-0.6667)-1 must be painted ground pavement (rows -16..-9 / -5 / -4 / 3 / 4 / 9..14), never grass/water/road
body cells clear of roads (rows -8/-7/7/8 full width; avenue cols -18/-17/17/18 for rows -16..-4 and 3..14), water rows -3..2, and all 14 building footprints
center distances: >= 2.2 to every seat, >= 2.0 to every robot, >= 2.8 to every vehicle center
body vs neon sign: NOT(|dx| < w/2+1.065 AND |dy| < h/2+1.065)
tag framing: |x|+1.375 <= 35.256, tag y span inside tint band, bubble top y+3.4834 <= 15
law.assignment: deterministic pick in StreetBehaviorRules (bucket members by roster slot order, first takes the district slot, overflow stays home)
law.fallback: districts with no slot (QUANT / GAME) and visitors (OR/RV) shelter at the home position - honest fallback, umbrella semantics per r122 law c
law.quota_verdict: r122 pre-registered first batch = 2 per city district + 1 north (7). Geometry-feasible candidates under the hard gates = 3 (MEDIA E1-north wide window, NORTH B3-west window, NORTH B2-west narrow window). Selected = 2 (quota), B2-west kept as runner-up. Root cause of the shortfall: the r104 seat re-anchor ringed the tower feet (Q02/Q03/Q04/Q06 / M01/M04/M05/M08 / T01-N01 flanks) and street furniture (kiosk, food+fruit carts, camper, bus) occupies the remaining eave-adjacent cells; the r99-family clearance gates are hard law (no silent weakening). Remedy candidates for fuller coverage (CEO option, NOT this round): (a) seat-move round freeing eave cells, (b) arcade/awning asset line (S-library acquisition).
